Figure5| Self-correction performance on different sets of firstattempt responses: (a) "fixed": first response is sampled from the initial model, (b) "self-generated": first response is generated by the learner itself. Throughout training, the correction rate on fixed responses increases for both train and validation problems, but degrades substantially on self-generated responses. This indicates that training on a fixed offline dataset of correction traces suffers from distribution shift.
